players.note: Great player, excellent ceiling. I just think his ECR of WR8 is rich. Matthew Golden is much closer to CWat than most would like to admit.
Throw out the Week 7 game script. Chuba has three favorable matchups upcoming, so he should be just fine.
Jettas has only one 100-yard receiving game in his last 17 games. It's time to admit he's past his prime, and maybe K1 isn't the answer to get him back on track.

Poor game against NYG and now headed into his bye week. If you have to sell because you're outside the playoff picture, that's understandable. But his value hasn't been lower. I'd hold and wait for a bounce-back in Week 9 if you have the luxury.
Week 7 was an anomaly. Nobody in this offense performed. Best on a bounce-back from Bryce Young and this offense in Week 8.
Pacing for 107 targets this season. Sure, this offensive line sucks, but the receiving upside Jeanty has provides such an excellent floor.
He's not a good rusher, plain and simple. Samaje Perine is sniping high-value touches, and Brown is no longer the workhorse.
Ugh, two horrendous games for AJB post-injury. But it's still AJB, it's still Drake Maye throwing him the football, and there's still zero competition for targets around him. I'm holding.
Same as Chuba, I'm not over-analyzing the game against Tampa Bay. It was unfortunate, but we have much more evidence to sugget this Carolina offense is very good.

We're giving our guy one last show (assuming he passes concussion protocol) in Week 8. McDaniel's job is on the line, and honestly, Justin Herbert's leash may be getting short. They NEED to have a good game against the Rams.
Down week from Germ in Week 7. I'm not panicking; he's still the WR2 in this offense (at worst) and complements Aaron Rodgers' playstle perfectly.
It's over for Downs. We've had back-to-back games without Tyler Warren, and he still couldn't get it done. There's no way you can start him on a competitive team.
Hat trick from Tony Pollard in Week 7! It's the perfect time to sell high. Pollard is still washed, and this offense is horrendous. This may be your only chance to sell.
He's not finding the endzone, but the usage is tremendous. Very safe floor with KCC.
Coming off of a stinker and headed into a bye week, you won't be able to get nearly as much for Likely as you would've last week. I'm hanging on and plugging him right back into the lineup in Week 9.
No Rashee in Week 7, and Worthy STILL couldn't get it done. Granted, Seattle stymied this offense as a whole. But still, I'd expect more than 11 receiving yards given the opportunity.
Hit the ground running post-injury; no need to complicate this one. Buy buy buy.
Not a great Week 7 performance from Kelce, but he still outperformed the rest of this receiving corps. He's still a safe floor, medium ceiling play in my opinion.
This is now a gross committee, and Aaron Jones suffered a knee injury late into the game in Week 7. He's no longer startable.
Shane Steichen is coaching for his job. I don't expect this Colts team to shut it down anytime soon, and Warren is the clear top option in the passing game. Just need him to get healthy.

He's rocking a 47% target rate in Houston; he just hasn't run many routes. Maybe he needs more time to learn the playbook? If he can keep just a fraction of that efficiency on a full route share, he could be a smash.
With Terry Mclaurin out for the year, routes and targets are opening up for AW. He may be a rookie, but this kid is #GoodAtFootball.

JCM is on IR for at least a couple more weeks, and Washington is past their bye week. White is a terrible rusher, so he'll never be fully trusted in that role. However, he's an excellent pass-catcher, making his worth starting in your FLEX.
Back-to-back game with 6+ targets for Chig. He's going to project for one of the largest target shares at his position rest-of-season.
You're not getting any return on the trade market, but his theoretical ceiling is far too high to drop. Just keep him stashed on your bench for the time being.

I was hoping for a Week 7 bounce-back to sell high with Juwan. New Orleans is on bye this week, but maybe you can sell him based on his favorable rest-of-season schedule. I just want to sell before Jordyn Tyson returns.
We're holding and waiting for the trade news to come across our phones. If he stays in Jacksonville, and the deadline passes, it may be safe to drop. For now, keep him on your bench.
With Jonah Coleman back, this is now a three-man committee. The only Denver RB I'd consider starting in fantasy right now is RJ Harvey, given his explosive playstyle and receiving role.
